scripts.dev: npm run build:pkgs && npm --workspace shared run build && npm run dev:db:up && concurrently -k -n server,client,db -c blue,magenta,yellow "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client" "npm:dev:db:logs"
scripts.dev:rts: npm run build:pkgs && npm --workspace shared run build && npm --workspace client run dev
scripts.dev:db:up: docker compose up -d --wait postgres redis && npm run migrate
scripts.build: npm run build:pkgs && npm --workspace shared run build && npm --workspace server run build && npm --workspace client run build && npm run check:bundle
scripts.capture:rts: npm run build:pkgs && npm --workspace shared run build && node scripts/shoot-rts.cjs
scripts.smoke:rts:browser: npm run build:pkgs && npm --workspace shared run build && node scripts/smoke-rts-browser-owned.cjs
scripts.dev:lab: npm run build:pkgs && npm --workspace @tower/voxel-lab run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5184
scripts.smoke:assets: npm run build:pkgs && node --import tsx scripts/smoke-character-assets.ts && node --import tsx scripts/smoke-character-runtime.ts && node --import tsx scripts/smoke-lab-backend.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run check:engine && npm --workspace @tower/voxel-lab run typecheck && npm --workspace shared run typecheck && npm --workspace server run typecheck && npm --workspace client run typecheck
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:up && npm run migrate
